title: The latest release is buggy and not very good
body: I’ve been a Productive user for almost two years. The latest release is buggy (they’ve acknowledged it on my support request) and you will end up having streaks ruined even after you’ve completed contributing habits. The new user interface is also a classic case of making something look pretty...at the cost of usability. The old interface was straightforward and simple but now I have to deal with swiping across to see missed habits/activities and the top third of the screen is a silly graphic which stops being cute after the first use.

title: Productive App

My only frustration (recently) is that my history for the current year seems to have disappeared from about Oct 2019 back to Jan 2019) ... these are important Stats for me as I like to look back at the months & years & see how I have done / progressed & the stats seem to have all disappeared 😳😵😢🤕 ...

Other than this. It is a truly AWESOME App.

title: App is reactive not proactive
body:
This app is great, except: I cannot view future tasks for the week ahead. 
In the beginning of a week I like to know what my tasks are, as I want to be proactive, not reactive. 

This app makes the user reactive, which is not conducive to create longterm routines, which is why I want to use the app to get me into a routine. 

At this stage, if I add “end if the month”, when is end of the month? If something needs to be done on a work day end of the month, and end of the month falls on a Saturday the task is now not “relevant”? 

Suggestion
It would be great if dates can be added to tasks.
As well as a future calendar view.
